question: Do the six ArtificialAnalysis/Earnings22-Cleaned-AA calls overlap the ESB Earnings-22 train split?
method: esb/datasets is gated and the supplied read token is not in its authorized list (HTTP 403). Instead read only the source_id column (parquet column projection, no audio) of the public ESB-derived mirror sanchit-gandhi/earnings22_split and compared call ids. The mirror's train split is the whole 125-call corpus (it also contains the validation and test calls), so membership is decided by exclusion: ESB train = corpus minus validation minus test.
caveats: inference by exclusion, not a read of the authoritative esb/datasets lists
mirror test has 2735 segments versus the leaderboard's 2741 utterances (same six calls)
consequence: Earnings22-Cleaned-AA is train-contaminable for arms trained on ESB; label train-overlap-yes-inferred; ordering and sanity only.
